task: Switch the WAL archiving alert to the observed cnpg_collector_pg_wal_archive_status{value="ready"} backlog metric because default queries fail on the missing bootstrap database 'authentik'. Pin with R326 promtool cases and mutations.

events.summary: Change only the WAL archiving alert in gitops/resources/prometheus-alerts.yaml, update R326 check-cnpg-monitoring-alerts.py test cases and mutations, and document decision D1 in docs/common/lessons-log.md. Deliberately left alone: database-ingress-policy, bootstrap initdb configuration, other alert rules in prometheus-alerts.yaml, live cluster state, git push/PR/merge.

PR #602 took WAL archiving alert metric names (cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_failed_count and seconds_since_last_archival) from documentation without live verification. On the live cluster, bootstrap.initdb.database=authentik points to a non-existent database, causing CNPG 1.29.1 exporter default user queries to fail with 'database "authentik" does not exist (SQLSTATE 3D000)'. Even with cnpg_collector_up=1, SQL query metrics fail and the WAL archiving alert stayed silent.

D1 / D-CNPG-WAL-ARCHIVE-ALERT: switch CNPGWALArchivingFailing alert rule to cnpg_collector_pg_wal_archive_status{namespace="database",value="ready"} > 0 for 30m with critical severity. This observed exporter metric does not depend on SQL query execution and detects both growing backlogs and single stuck WAL segments. Updated R326 promtool test cases and 26 mutation checks, and documented decision D1 in lessons-log.md.
